adopted.change: Reuse the existing IQ2_S paired gate/up kernel for Q2_0; share Q8 activation decode, preserve eight-lane sum order.
adopted.enablement: A770, GU Q2_0, n_embd=2560, GU_LANES=8, grouped v2, old/split kernels disabled

mode_descriptions.1: IQ2_XXS Multi via existing Split decoder, E4/E2 reuse
mode_descriptions.2: IQ2_XXS Multi via SWAR decoder, E4/E2 reuse
mode_descriptions.3: Paired gate/up SG16 WG128; IQ2_XXS LN16 or Q2_0 LN8
mode_descriptions.5: IQ2_XXS SWAR Multi SG16 separate gate/up

v2_mode_descriptions.1: IQ2_XXS Split decoder with E2-only reuse
v2_mode_descriptions.2: IQ2_XXS SWAR decoder with E2-only reuse

experiments.selection: Adopt only Q2 pairing; IQ2_XXS reuse regressed single-token latency, including the E2-only variants.

limitations: Real expert weights with deterministic Gaussian activations, not captured model activations.
Mapped-host weights are bandwidth-limited; this test shows no material speedup.
No new whole-model generation equivalence or quality conclusion; prior Q2 baseline-repeatability issue remains unresolved.
